witnesses.edition: Oscar von Gebhardt, Acta martyrum selecta (Berlin: A. Duncker, 1902)
witnesses.local_path: sources (scan read online; archive.org OCR corrected by reading against the printed Greek)
witnesses.note: Epistula ecclesiarum Viennensis et Lugdunensis (Eusebius HE 5.1-3). The scan OCR garbles Greek (e.g. xoi for καί, χυρίου for κυρίου); each locked section is corrected by reading, with corrections recorded in ocr_normalizations. Preserving work: Eusebius, Church History 5.1-3 — scope confined to the letter as printed by Gebhardt, not the Eusebian frame.
